cli: read-only; no attachment in any mode

actions.name: start
actions.description: Owning Pi: resolve/freeze a fresh run and optionally run bounded READ-ONLY native observations. No scoring or candidate edits before PR4+.

actions.name: inspect
actions.description: Read a consistent saved research projection. No attachment, writes or export generation.

actions.name: control
actions.description: Owning Pi: revision-bound pause/resume/cancel/steer receipt; acceptance is distinct from native settlement. No approval/apply subcommands.

actions.name: export
actions.description: Owning Pi: generate an unscored JSON research projection artifact idempotently. Never writes source material.

actions.name: propose
actions.description: Owner-only propose: exact bindings, reservations and evidence. Actor proposals are not authorization.

actions.name: dispatch
actions.description: Owner-only dispatch: exact bindings, reservations and evidence. Actor proposals are not authorization.

actions.name: collect
actions.description: Owner-only collect: exact bindings, reservations and evidence. Actor proposals are not authorization.

actions.name: evaluate
actions.description: Owner-only evaluate: exact bindings, reservations and evidence. Actor proposals are not authorization. Evaluators unavailable until PR4; caller scores forbidden.

actions.name: distill
actions.description: Owner-only distill: exact bindings, reservations and evidence. Actor proposals are not authorization.

actions.name: decide
actions.description: Owner-only decide: exact bindings, reservations and evidence. Actor proposals are not authorization.

actions.name: review
actions.description: Owning Pi UI only: request actual user response to exact pending decision after host permission. No supplied approval or receipt accepted; no measured keep/apply.

actions.name: apply
actions.description: Owning Pi only; unavailable until source-preimage/workspace implementation. Never treats review as Fabric permission.

actions.name: undoApply
actions.description: Owning Pi only; unavailable until source-preimage reconciliation implementation. No inverse is guessed.

actions.name: substrateStart
actions.description: Owner-only bounded execution binding (PR2 substrate, not scored research). Actor proposes; owner launches and waits. Repeated identical requests are idempotent.

actions.name: substrateInspect
actions.description: Read a retained execution binding and settlement facts; never starts work or exports.

actions.name: substrateCancel
actions.description: Owning Pi only: stop owned native work and await real settlement; ambiguity retains evidence.
